author: SinOfStrife
name: fox
short: Sends a random fox with an interesting fact.
description: Fetches a random fox image from randomfox.ca and a fun fox fact from some-random-api.com.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any personal or user data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the Fox cog! Use `[p]fox` to fetch a random fox and a fun fact. Note: This cog interacts with external web services (randomfox.ca and some-random-api.com).
